answer: The beacon edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 176 clones produces a signature the hollow analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Anyone must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the lagoon settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 28 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
